# To .NET Object.vi

![To .NET Object.vi function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/connectivity/NET-08.svg)

[Connectivity functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Converts supported numeric, string, Boolean, timestamp, path, .NET reference and array data to a .NET Framework object.
